Subject: Bakeoff credit reconciliation & usage terms

Hi Kimberly —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Medisys is running the RFP bake-off next month and we need to lock down how trial credits and any promotional top-ups will be handled. A couple of asks from procurement:

- Can Redwood provide a separate credit pool for Medisys evaluation that we can guarantee is not used in parallel for AuroraAI?
- We need an audit trail showing credit issuance and per-token consumption (for our review team).
- Are you able to split credits into milestone releases tied to test completion?

Attached: Medisys_RFP_SOW.pdf (pdf) — includes the high-level evaluation plan.

We'd like to get terms confirmed by Oct 18 so procurement and legal can include them in the SOW.

Thanks,
Claire

Head of Product, Medisys
claire@medisys.ai

Subject: Re: Bakeoff credit reconciliation & usage terms

Hi Claire —

Appreciate the SOW. Short answers up front: yes, we can create an isolated evaluation pool and provide token-level usage logs; we can also split the allocation into tranches tied to milestones. A few clarifying Qs so we size and scope the credits properly:

- Expected evaluation duration and peak QPS for the side-by-side tests? (This impacts how many tokens you’ll burn.)
- Will tests include long-context scenarios (10k+ tokens) or mostly short prompts?
- Do you require embargoed results (i.e., keep Redwood out of benchmark comparisons) or is standard PR allowed after the bake-off?

Proposed initial allocation (subject to internal approval): 40,000 evaluation credits + 60 day trial extension on our standard sandbox (isolated project). We can hold 20k in an escrow tranche and release 20k after the first milestone (completion of integration tests).

I’ve looped in Marissa (sales ops) for credit policy and Rafael (finance) for the escrow flow. If you confirm the evaluation profile above I’ll route for approval and prepare a credit_release_agreement.docx stub.

Best,
Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-15T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Bakeoff credit reconciliation & usage terms

Kimberly / Rafael —

Forwarding Claire’s ask. Quick notes from ops/policy side (we should capture these in the agreement):

- Standard promotional credit policy caps at 30k for first-stage trials; anything above requires a sales director sign-off and finance sign-off.
- For RFP/bake-offs where a competitor is involved we require:
  * A named evaluation project (isolated project id)
  * Token-usage export delivered weekly (CSV) to the customer
  * An anti-swap clause (Redwood won't reroute the same virtual pool to competitor trials during the active period)
- If we escrow credits we need milestone definitions and an acceptance criteria clause (who signs off on milestone completion).

Also: legal will want to add an audit window and retention term for logs (suggest 90 days). If we proceed with escrow, finance will want the payment/credit reconciliation workflow documented.

Attachment: credit_allocation_sheet.csv (csv) — quick calc based on short vs long prompt mixes.

Recommend: 30k allocated + 10k conditional release after integration acceptance. Rafael — can you confirm whether finance will accept a conditional escrow for a new enterprise trial?

-Marissa
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-16T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Bakeoff credit reconciliation & usage terms

Marissa / Kimberly —

I can provisionally approve the 30k + 10k conditional split under these constraints:

- Credits are recorded in our internal billing system under a dedicated project id and marked as promotional (no conversion to paid balance).
- Release schedule: 15k upfront, 15k on integration milestone, final 10k after acceptance testing sign-off by Medisys (name the signee).
- We require a signed credit release agreement that includes: anti-abuse terms, a 90-day audit log retention clause, and an acknowledgement that credits are non-transferrable.

I’ve drafted a one-page credit_release_agreement.docx that covers the above. If Medisys prefers an alternate escrow mechanism we can work it, but this is the path of least friction.

Also: security_compliance should be looped in if Claire expects any special log export (PII redaction, hosted vs. on-prem logs). Kimberly — can you confirm whether the logs will include sample prompts or only aggregate token counts?

-Rafael
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Claire Huang <claire@medisys.ai>, Procurement Ops <procurement@medisys.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-17T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Bakeoff credit reconciliation & usage terms

Claire —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. We can move forward with the following terms, pending your confirmation and signature:

1) Credit allocation
   - Total promotional credits: 30,000 tokens (15k upfront / 15k on integration milestone) + 10,000 conditional post-acceptance = 40,000 total.
2) Escrow & release
   - Credits will be held in a named, isolated project and released per the schedule above. Medisys to provide a named acceptance signee for final 10k release.
3) Audit & logs
   - Weekly CSV export of per-token counts and route-level breakdowns. No raw prompt text will be shared unless explicitly requested and approved by Redwood Security (PII redaction available). Logs retained for 90 days.
4) Usage restrictions
   - Credits are non-transferrable and restricted to the Medisys evaluation project; Redwood will not allocate the same evaluation pool to competing bake-offs during the active period.
5) Timeline and signature
   - Please review and sign the attached credit_release_agreement.docx. If you prefer DocuSign we can send a link. Need signature by Oct 20 to keep to your RFP schedule.

Attachments: credit_release_agreement.docx (docx), credit_allocation_sheet.csv (csv)

Next steps: confirm evaluation profile (short vs long prompts + expected QPS) and provide the name of the acceptance signee. Once we have that I’ll trigger the initial 15k allocation and share the weekly log exports.

Best,
Kimberly
